questions.question: 18257. The difference between two positive integers is 3. If the sum of their squares is 369, then the sum of the numbers is :
questions.explain:
Let the numbers be x and (x + 3)
Then, ⇔x2+(x+3)2=369
⇔x2+x2+9+6x=369
⇔2x2+6x−360=0
⇔x2+3x−180=0
⇔(x+15)(x−12)=0
⇔x=12
So, the numbers are 12 and 15
∴ Required sum = (12 + 15) = 27

questions.question: 18251. What kind of economy is prevalent in Bangladesh-
questions.explain:

Then Speed of A = 6X
Ratio of the speed of A and C = 1:6
So, Greater the speed less time taken in journey.
C’s speed is 6 times less than A
So A will take 1/6 of the total time taken C to covered same distance.
